rows.question: Where does Kestrel Fasteners plc expect to open a new plant?
rows.answer: Kestrel Fasteners plc expects to open a new plant near Kellyton, Alabama. This is referred to as the Kellyton Graphite Plant, located near Kellyton and five miles northwest of Alexander City, Alabama. The company has executed a land lease for approximately 70 acres to construct and operate this plant. Construction activities for Phase I began in the fourth quarter of 2021, with testing and commissioning expected in late 2023 and first production in the first half of 2024, subject to securing additional funding [S1][S3][S5].
